PB44-011.name: ［Blooming Coord］Kitaouji Sakura ［2］
PB44-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Summoned)
Until your next Main Step, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your "Idol" family Spirit.

[LV2][LV3]
Your Cost 4 or less "Idol" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

PB44-008.name: ［Goth Magic Coord］Toudou Yurika ［2］
PB44-008.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Trash. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to your Life.

PB44-X02.name: ［Lilac Fairy Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo ［2］
PB44-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Hoshimiya Ichigo" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Starlight Appeal] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, you can summon an "Idol" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
Every "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi"/"Shibuki Ran" you control gains an extra Yellow symbol, and is unaffected by opposing effects.

PB44-003.name: ［Mermaid Pisces Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo ［2］
PB44-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Hoshimiya Ichigo" & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits to the deckbottom. If you have four counters or more, the "10000 BP or less" written in this effect changes to "15000 BP or less".

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] [Starlight Appeal]
When your "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi"/"Shibuki Ran" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, all those targets remain on the Field, exhausted.

PB44-005.name: ［Milky Way Cosmic Coord］Kiriya Aoi ［2］
PB44-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash, When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When you would activate the "send cores from this Spirit to the Trash" effect of [Starlight Appeal], you can activate it, treating as if a core is sent to the Trash.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.

PB44-010.name: ［Pierrot Carnival Coord］Ichinose Kaede ［2］
PB44-010.effect:
When your Spirit [advents], you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Idol" family card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to either the decktop or deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, your counter +2.

PB44-002.name: ［Pink Stage Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PB44-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Hoshimiya Ichigo", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Starlight Appeal] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can return an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

PB44-007.name: ［Rose Bonbon Coord］Shibuki Ran ［2］
PB44-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and destroy it if it is brought to 0 BP. Then, you can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, return an "Idol" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While you control any Cost 5 or more "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi", effects of every opposing Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

PB44-X01.name: ［Star Festival Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PB44-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Hoshimiya Ichigo" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Return opposing LV1/LV2 Spirits, one of each, to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] [Starlight Appeal] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to your "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi"/"Shibuki Ran", one of each.

PB44-006.name: ［Starlight Academy Uniform - Summer Uniform］Shibuki Ran
PB44-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return an "Idol" family Spirit card/Nexus card from your Trash to the Hand. When you've done so, your counter +1.

[LV2] [Aikatsu On Stage] (When Attacks)
You can put a "Stage Style" family "Shibuki Ran" from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand, and summon the card you put onto the Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

PB44-001.name: ［Starlight Academy Uniform - Summer Uniform］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PB44-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to another "Hoshimiya Ichigo" you control.

[LV2] [Aikatsu On Stage] (When Attacks)
You can put a "Stage Style" family "Hoshimiya Ichigo" from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand, and summon the card you put onto the Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

PB44-004.name: ［Starlight Academy Uniform - Summer Uniform］Kiriya Aoi
PB44-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Hoshimiya Ichigo" and, besides "［Starlight Academy Uniform - Summer Uniform］Kiriya Aoi", an "Idol" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop or deckbottom only.

[LV2] [Aikatsu On Stage] (When Attacks)
You can put a "Stage Style" family "Kiriya Aoi" from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand, and summon the card you put onto the Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

PB44-009.name: ［Tropical Basket Coord］Arisugawa Otome ［2］
PB44-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Put a core from the Void to your other "Idol" family Spirit. If you have four counters or more, this effect puts +1 core.

[LV3] [Starlight Appeal] (When Attacks)
You can send a core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, besides any "Arisugawa Otome", you can summon/deploy an "Idol" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

PB44-CX01.name: ［Aikatsu! is Starting］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PB44-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Idol" family Spirit attacks, your counters +2, and draw a card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi"/"Shibuki Ran" from your Hand, without paying the cost. If you have six counters or more, change the "Cost 4 or less" written in this effect to "Cost 7 or less"
